title: Two-Dimensional Stabilization of Quartic del Pezzo Surfaces
description: Let k be a field of characteristic zero and S/k a smooth quartic del Pezzo surface with a rational point and stably permutation geometric Picard lattice. This preprint proves that S times A^2, equivalently S times P^2, is k-rational. It applies the theorem to both explicit Tschinkel–Zhang families of smooth cubic hypersurfaces over Q. For their cubic threefolds, the result and a separately cited theorem that X times P^1 is irrational give stabilization index two over Q and C. Consequently there are smooth projective nonrational fourfolds Y over Q for which Y times A^1 is rational. This is a statement about birational rationality after affine-line stabilization, not a counterexample to Zariski cancellation. The release includes an exact-arithmetic certificate for the tangent-incidence calculation; the new rationality theorem is not formalized in Lean.
notes: Correspondence: tavisrudd@damnsimple.com. Main source: cubic_stabilization_irrationality.tex; manuscript PDF: cubic_stabilization_irrationality.pdf. Reproduce the manuscript and exact certificate with `make check`.
